note: Models whose output is text only. Prices are USD per million tokens (API gives USD per token). Excluded: ":free" and ":batch" variants, zero-priced models, and routers with variable pricing (-1). weeklyTokensT is the model's tokens in the most recent complete week in which it was in the Top Models chart (weeklyTokensWeek); models never in a weekly top 9 have none. weeklyFreeTokensT is the same for the model's ":free" variant. Joined on canonical_slug = ranking permaslug.
